title: Asking whether it changed
blurb: `Page` has carried an ETag since the first fetch in this crate and nothing ever sent it back, so a page past its hour cost a whole download to learn that nothing about it had changed. It is asked about now, and a 304 carries no body in either direction — and a page the origin confirms is dated now rather than when we first read it. The other half of the row is a bound on the run: everything else in the crate bounds one request, and eight pages times three companies is an accident of arithmetic rather than a limit.
